    Encoder

    Control strategies this shooter can select between while running.

    Swerve module component encapsulating a drive motor, azimuth (steer) motor, and encoder, with methods to apply desired states and read current state/position.
    MotorComponent
    Base component for any mechanism driven by a motor, providing setpoint application and input logging for a leader motor and any number of followers.
    PositionComponent
    Extension of MotorComponent that adds debounced proximity checks for position setpoints.
    Setpoint
    Represents a motor control setpoint (neutral, voltage, duty cycle, velocity, or position) and provides factory methods for each mode.
    Setpoint.Mode
    Enumerates the available motor control modes.
    Turret
    Position component for a turret, adding absolute-position resolution from a pair of encoders and aiming helpers that compensate for robot motion.
    Turret.TurretInputs
    Pre-filter turret setpoint, logged alongside the motor inputs rather than as an output.
    Turret.TurretOutput
    Aiming solution for a single target, pairing the turret setpoint with the shot distance that downstream mechanisms (hood angle, flywheel speed) interpolate against.
    VelocityComponent
    Extension of MotorComponent that adds debounced proximity checks for velocity setpoints.

    Component wrapper for a vision camera hardware interface, handling input updates and AdvantageKit logging.
